comment: One Light. Source: https://github.com/atom/one-light-syntax (styles/colors.less and styles/syntax-variables.less; HSL values converted to hex). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2016 GitHub Inc.; the text is in LICENSE-one. Roles: text = mono-1 hsl(230,8%,24%), weak = mono-2 hsl(230,6%,44%), rule = mono-3 hsl(230,4%,64%), accent = hue-3 hsl(301,63%,40%), run = hue-2 hsl(221,87%,60%), ok = hue-4 hsl(119,34%,47%), error = hue-5 hsl(5,74%,59%), add = syntax-color-added hsl(132,60%,44%), remove = syntax-color-removed hsl(0,100%,54%), tint = syntax-selection-color darken(bg,8%), code = gutter-background-color-selected darken(bg,8%), background = syntax-bg hsl(230,1%,98%). Adjusted for contrast, nothing else changed: add #2db448 (syntax-color-added hsl(132,60%,44%)) -> #29a341: lightness 44% -> 40% for 3:1 on #fafafa (was 2.60:1).
